notes.title: Update, version 2.1.3
notes.content:
Hi guys

Starship Intruder has been updated to version 2.1.3. Most changes are minor, but some noteable ones are:

- More ammo (bolts)
- Range of bolts now covers the entire screen - but will be more inprecise plus increased travel time
- Added another space card. Drawing this card will produce a scatter-bolt shot from your ship. 

Thanks for reading. 

Isocube Software
